findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no access control or policy restricting access, exposing objects to unauthenticated public reads. The data_object contains customer master data (customer-master.xlsx), making it a sensitive data exposure risk.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects stored in it, including the customer master spreadsheet, are unencrypted at rest.
The object holding customer master data is stored in an unencrypted bucket without server-side encryption, leaving sensitive customer data at rest in cleartext.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so financial data stored in it is unencrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving data at rest unencrypted.
The data_science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving data at rest unencrypted.
Versioning is disabled on the data bucket, so no recovery is possible for accidental overwrites or deletions and there is no history to support forensic analysis of the customer data it holds.
The bucket has no access logging, eliminating the audit trail needed to detect unauthorized access to the customer data it contains.
The financials bucket has no access logging, eliminating the audit trail needed to detect unauthorized access to financial data.
The operations bucket has no access logging, eliminating the audit trail needed to detect unauthorized access.
